# Northeast Damp Proofers

> Independent damp and timber specialists in the North East of England, led by Jeff Webb (PCA Qualified Technician in Damp and Timber, PCAQT, Certificate No. 957) and Dan (based in Durham). Covering Newcastle upon Tyne, Gateshead, Sunderland, Durham, Tyneside and Northumberland.

Phone: 07446 522034
Email: info@northeastdampproofers.co.uk
Opening hours: Monday to Friday 8am–5pm, Saturday 8am–12pm
Website: https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/

## Services
- [All services and "Which service do I need?" guide](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html): symptoms mapped to likely causes, plus FAQs. Free damp inspection; written damp survey report from £150
- [Damp surveys and written reports](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html#damp-survey-report): moisture readings, diagnosis and a written report
- [Rising damp treatment](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html#rising-damp): diagnosis, damp-proof course and re-plastering
- [Penetrating damp](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html#penetrating-damp): finding and fixing water ingress
- [Condensation and mould advice](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html#condensation-mould): ventilation and humidity solutions
- [Basement and cellar waterproofing](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html#waterproofing): tanking and membrane systems

## Areas
- [Damp proofing and damp surveys in Newcastle upon Tyne](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-proofing-newcastle.html): Tyneside flats, Victorian terraces, cellars and rented homes across Newcastle

## Blog
- [Has my damp-proof course failed? Why it's often just bridged](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/has-my-damp-proof-course-failed.html): how to tell a failed damp-proof course from a bridged one, what homeowners can check themselves, and when injection is and isn't needed
- [Dry rot or wet rot? How to tell the difference](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/dry-rot-or-wet-rot.html): how to tell dry rot from wet rot, why moisture is always the cause, and how each is repaired
- [Damp patch after heavy rain? It's probably penetrating damp](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-patch-after-heavy-rain.html): why damp patches appear after heavy rain, the usual causes in North East homes, what to check yourself and when to get a survey
- [Damp on your homebuyer survey? What to do next](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-on-homebuyer-survey.html): what it means when a homebuyer survey or mortgage valuation flags damp, what to do before exchange, and how to avoid cowboy quotes
- [Awaab's Law phase two: what changes on 30 November](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/awaabs-law-phase-two-damp-cold-homes.html): what phase two adds, the deadlines for social landlords, and what it means for damp, mould and cold homes
- [Black mould in winter: condensation or rising damp?](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/black-mould-condensation-or-rising-damp.html): how to tell condensation from rising damp and what to do about each
